https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-her.analysis: It’s hard to write these quotes without sounding “clicky,” but Harbaugh was forthright at his Monday press conference when asked about Herbert’s decision-making. “Be better. Be better,” Harbaugh said before attempting to soften the blow. “And that drives Justin, that drives me, that drives his position coach, that drives (OC Mike [McDaniel). I mean, drives us all.” Harbaugh also said the team could look to simplify McDaniel’s complex scheme. “As far as the scheme going forward, all options are open,” Harbaugh claimed. When asked what that might entail, the coach responded “run, pass, up the middle, motion, no motion.” Alrighty then. It’s shocking to hear a coach talk this frankly — especially Harbaugh about Herbert — but the situation really is that dire in Los Angeles. Herbert is in the crossfire, but it could be McDaniel who is on something of a hot seat with his play-calling. Sitting at 0-3, the Chargers face the unwelcome prospect of a “must win” Week 4 contest against defending Super Bowl champion Seattle, itself coming off a rough loss. We will be benching Herbert in fantasy for that one.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-her.headline: Justin Herbert completed 20-of-34 passes for 226 yards, one touchdown and one interception in the Chargers’ 24-16, Week 3 loss to the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-her.analysis: On one hand, Herbert was under constant pressure in this game behind a beat-up offensive line and was able to evade pressure regularly and extend plays. On the other hand, he really wasn’t able to get anything going down the field. His one touchdown “pass” was on a handoff where he essentially let go of the ball and Keaton Mitchell took the “forward pass” into the end zone on a jet sweep. Herbert’s interception was a terrible pass in the end zone when the Chargers were up 13-10 and looking to put the game away. The Bills also dropped two other potential interceptions. Herbert looks pretty firmly like a QB2 here, and it’s hard to get overly excited about playing him next week against the Seahawks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-her.headline: Justin Herbert completed 15-of-27 passes for 192 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in the Chargers’ 24-14, Week 2 loss to the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-her.analysis: The Chargers were an uncoordinated mess in this one. They committed loads of procedural penalties on offense, had several drops, and botched multiple handoffs or snaps. Their final penalty was holding in their own end zone, resulting in a safety. David Njoku handed Herbert’s first interception to a defender, but the second pick was all his fault. Herbert fired into a non-existent window on a deep shot and was easily intercepted by the Vegas secondary. Herbert also committed two fumbles, though both were recovered by the Chargers. Sitting at 0-2 with murderer’s row of opponents on deck, something has to change in a hurry for the Chargers. Herbert will shuffle into the QB2 ranks for his Week 3 date with the Bills.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-her.headline: Justin Herbert completed 17-of-27 pass attempts for 209 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Chargers’ Week 1 loss to the Cardinals, adding five rushes for 29 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-her.analysis: Herbert shredded the Arizona secondary in the Bolts’ first drive of the game. From there he struggled to complete even routine passes and got nothing going downfield. Ladd McConkey’s exit from the ballgame in the third quarter all but ended Herbert’s production for the day. Herbert, to his credit, tried to push the ball downfield, averaging 10.8 intended air yards per attempt, the fourth highest mark of Week 1. The Cards’ time of possession domination limited play volume for LA, torpedoing fantasy prospects across the board. Hopefully for Herbert, the Chargers will have McConkey back for Week 2 against the Raiders. Herbert will be a borderline top-12 option.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: Colts signed P Thomas Morstead to the practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: Morstead spent 12 years punting for the Saints before making stops with the Jets, Falcons, Dolphins, and 49ers over the last five seasons. The 40-year-old veteran averaged 43.6 yards per punt for San Francisco last year. Current Colts punter Rigoberto Sanchez was injured during a blocked punt in the Colts’ Week 6 loss to the Titans. Morstead joins the Colts’ practice squad as insurance in case Sanchez cannot play Week 7 against the Vikings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: 49ers signed P Thomas Morstead, formerly of the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: Morstead will enter his 17th NFL season with the Niners after spending the past two years with the Jets. Morstead, 39, has played for four other teams since entering the league in 2007. In 2024, he ranked 25th in net punting average (41 yards) and a career-high touchback rate of 11.1 percent.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: Jets released P Thomas Morstead.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: Austin McNamara and Kai Kroeger will compete for the Jets punter job this year. The 39-year-old former Saint was the league’s oldest punter last season. If he wants to keep punting, he can absolutely join the tryout circuit or a competition elsewhere. But this is probably a sign that Morstead’s 16-year career is close to an end at this point.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: Jets re-signed P Thomas Morstead to a two-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: The deal is worth “over” $5 million. One of the top vibes-based players in the NFL, Morstead is merely an average punter at this point. He was 19th in net-punting average last season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: Jets re-signed P Thomas Morstead.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: Morstead was left off the final 53 but was always likely to return following the waiver window. The 14-year veteran remains one of the league’s premier punters and gives the Jets an established and consistent presence on special teams.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: Jets signed P Thomas Morstead, formerly of the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: Morstead spent the first 12 years of his career with the Saints before joining the Jets in 2021. He was released midseason and spent the remainder of the year in Atlanta. Morstead then joined the Dolphins this past year. He will compete with Braden Mann for punting duties in New York during the summer.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: Dolphins signed P Thomas Morstead, formerly of the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: The aged veteran will move on to his fourth team in three years after starting his NFL career with 12 seasons in New Orleans. He most recently punted for the Falcons in 2021, when he finished seventh in average punt distance. Morstead was tenth in punts inside the 20 yard line last season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: Falcons signed P Thomas Morstead.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: Falcons P Dustin Colquitt was placed on the reserve/COVID-19 list on Monday. Morstead spent 12 years with the Saints before being waived in March. He played six games for the Jets earlier this year, and now he lands in Atlanta to punt for the Falcons while Colquitt is out.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: Jets signed P Thomas Morstead.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: It’s a necessary addition after the team lost Braden Mann to a knee injury. Morstead set career lows in yards per punt (43.1) and longest punt (58) in his age-34 season with New Orleans, the only organization he’s played under to this point. He’ll be active in Week 2 against the Patriots.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.headline: Saints released P Thomas Morstead.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/thomas-mor.analysis: Morstead set career lows in yards per punt (43.1) and longest punt (58) in his age-34 season last year. He plans to return and prove that his down season was solely injury related. Morstead’s release is a reminder that the Saints’ offseason will be full of transactions given their salary cap situation. He’s played his entire career in New Orleans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports Terrance Ferguson (ankle) “will take some time” to come off injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Ferguson is eligible to come off injured reserve next week, but Schefter reports that a source told him Ferguson’s recovery “will take some time.” The Rams placed Davante Adams on injured reserve this week and are in desperate need of pass-catching help behind Puka Nacua. Ferguson is a rising receiving tight end for the Rams, but has been on injured reserve since suffering an ankle injury in Week 3. Though he is a good IR stash for fantasy purposes, Ferguson is going to take longer than the minimum four weeks to return. Without a good timeline for return, he can be released from fantasy rosters in dire need of more immediate help during bye weeks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rams placed Terrance Ferguson on injured reserve with an ankle injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: This escalated quickly. Ferguson briefly returned in Week 3 after getting X-rays on his injured ankle, but he was ultimately unable to continue. Ferguson can be kept on squads possessing an injured reserve spot, but dropping him for a needed starter makes sense. He will be eligible to return in Week 8 against the Chargers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rams ruled out Terrance Ferguson (ankle) for Week 4 against the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Ferguson suffered the ankle injury in Week 3 against the Broncos and was taken to the locker room for X-rays. He was cleared to return, but only did so briefly. The intriguing youngster remains a worthwhile hold, but he could end up being questionable to play next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) was held out of Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Coach Sean McVay said earlier this week that Ferguson was unlikely to play against the Eagles, and this certainly puts him on the “out” trajectory. The timing could not possibly be worse, as Ferguson was finally producing a little bit, and Puka Nacua (groin) is now set to return. That makes Ferguson a shaky hold in standard-sized 12-team leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rams HC Sean McVay said TE Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will likely miss Week 4 against the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Ferguson briefly departed after injuring his ankle in the team’s Sunday Night Football loss to the Broncos, returning for two snaps prior to departing again after his lone reception of the evening. The ankle injury now appears likely to cost the talented young tight end at least one game, with the potential for the absence to linger if the sprain is “more high than low.” McVay also relayed that fellow tight end Colby Parkinson suffered an AC sprain and is considered day-to-day. Veteran Tyler Higbee would be in line to operate as the primary receiving tight end after amassing 62 yards and a touchdown on eight receptions in Week 3, should both miss. Higbee should be added in all formats as a potential TE1 in the immediate future.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rams TE Terrance Ferguson (ankle) left the game a second time in the second quarter of Week 3 against the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Ferguson initially departed after being tangled up on a target in the first quarter. He was taken to the locker room for x-rays but returned after missing only one drive. He would then depart again following his lone reception and would not return the rest of the game. Ferguson caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards prior to departing for good. His status for Week 4 would appear to be murky at this point.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rams TE Terrance Ferguson (ankle) was taken to the locker room for x-rays in the first quarter of Week 3 against the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Ferguson got tangled up on a target half way through the first quarter and limped to the sideline under his own power. He was then escorted to the locker room for x-rays. No additional update has been provided.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rams coach Sean McVay said Colby Parkinson (knee) is “trending in the right direction” for Week 3 against the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Parkinson did not practice once this week because of the knee issue, so it’s a bit of a surprise that McVay sounds optimistic about him suiting up today. The team may have kept him out of practice as a precaution. He will handle an inline tight end role while Terrance Ferguson handles de facto WR2 duties with Puka Nacua out. Ferguson remains in the TE1 mix while Parkinson is a touchdown-or-bust TE2.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rams TE Terrance Ferguson (ankle) was removed from the injury report and will play in Week 3 against the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Ferguson is set to handle No. 2 pass-catcher duties with WR Puka Nacua (hip) sidelined this week. The young tight end posted a 6/54/1 receiving line in Week 2 and can be viewed as a TE1 in this matchup.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) is doubtful to play in Week 3 against the Broncos, but should play in Week 4 against the Eagles, barring a setback.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Nacua will not practice today, either. The bad news comes straight from Rams coach Sean McVay. With Nacua sidelined, WR Davante Adams must be treated as a fantasy football WR1 and TE Terrance Ferguson can be expected to operate as the team’s No. 2 pass catcher. He is a worthwhile TE1 starter.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: Jordan Schultz reports teams seeking wideout help believe Hollywood Brown could be traded in the coming weeks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: Brown had two rushes for 12 yards against the Titans in Week 2 (not receptions) and has been inactive in every other week of the season. So, yeah, we guess he could be had. As could any of the several veteran receivers on losing teams who actually have caught a pass this year.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: Eagles declared WR Hollywood Brown, RB Saquon Barkley, S Michael Carter II, EDGE A.J. Epenesa, EDGE Jalyx Hunt, and QB Joe Milton inactive for Week 6 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: Despite the Eagles’ absurdly lengthy injury report, they only had one player listed as questionable for Week 6. That was center Drew Kendall, who is active. Brown was dealing with an ankle issue earlier this week but was cleared from the injury report on Friday, making him a healthy scratch.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: Wicks suffered the hamstring injury in practice last week but played through the injury in the Eagles’ Week 5 loss to the Jaguars. Also limited was Hollywood Brown (ankle). Brown has not played since suffering an ankle injury in Week 2 but has a chance to return this week. Expect Wicks to play in Week 6 while Brown is truly questionable.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) was added to the injury report on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: Wicks was listed as a limited participant today, indicating that he strained his hamstring during Thursday’s practice. With DeVonta Smith (hamstring) still sidelined, rookie WR Makai Lemon could be the de facto top receiver, though the team has struggled to use him effectively thus far. Hollywood Brown (ankle) also remains sidelined.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: Eagles WR Devonta Smith (hamstring) did not participate in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: Smith still has not returned to practice since last week, continuing to deal with a hamstring injury. Given his lack of practice reps ahead of travelling to London for Week 5, Smith is on the wrong side of questionable for this week’s matchup against the Jaguars. Also not practicing was WR Hollywood Brown (ankle). The Eagles will play Week 5 with a severely banged-up skill position group.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: The Philly Voice’s Jimmy Kempski believes Eagles WR Dontayvian Wicks will “probably” be the team’s No. 2 wideout if A.J. Brown is traded this offseason.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: Wicks should slot in as the Eagles WR behind DeVonta Smith, Kempski said, because the former Packer is “younger, the Eagles invested more in him than they did in [Marquise] Brown, he is under contract for two years vs. one for Brown, and he seemingly already has the trust of offensive coordinator Sean Mannion.” The Eagles acquired Wicks from Green Bay this month in exchange for a 2026 fifth round draft pick and a 2027 sixth rounder. He had 108 receptions, 1,328 yards, and 11 touchdowns over three seasons with the Packers, operating mostly as a high-variance downfield threat. Kempski described Wicks as “a hard-nosed, rugged player who offers far more as a blocker in the run game than [A.J.] Brown does. How much that actually should matter is debatable, but my sense is that it will matter a lot in this new scheme.”

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: Eagles acquired WR Dontayvion Wicks from the Packers in exchange for a 2026 fifth-round pick and a 2027 sixth-round pick.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: ESPN’s Adam Schefter breaks the news, adding that Wicks will now sign a one-year, $12.5 million extension with the Eagles. Over the last four weeks, they also signed WR Hollywood Brown and WR Elijah Moore as well. Schefter reminds us that if the Eagles were to trade away WR A.J. Brown, that would probably happen after June 1st, “when the cap burden would be more manageable for the Eagles.” As things currently stand, Wicks will likely compete for WR3 duties. The trade also leaves Packers WR Christian Watson, WR Jayden Reed and WR Matthew Golden as the team’s top-three options after allowing WR Romeo Doubs to sign with the Patriots last month. The Eagles tacked on an additional year to Wicks’ contract after the deal, tying him to the franchise through the 2027 season. The extension includes $12.5 million in maximum money with $9 million guaranteed.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: Eagles signed WR Hollywood Brown, formerly of the Chiefs, to a one-year contract worth up to $6.5 million.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: This move could be interpreted one of two ways. Brown could be slotted into the distant WR3 role behind A.J. Brown and DeVonta Smith, or he could be a No. 2 option behind Smith if the Eagles eventually part ways this offseason with the mercurial Brown. Brown in 2025 was an afterthought in the Kansas City, totaling 587 yards and five touchdowns over 16 games. He was targeted on a ho-hum 20 percent of his pass routes last year as a part-time player in a dysfunctional Chiefs offense. Brown, entering his age-29 season, could have some WR3/4 value in deeper fantasy formats if the Eagles trade away Brown in the coming weeks or months.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: Hollywood Brown caught 2-of-4 targets for 13 yards in the Chiefs’ Week 18 loss against the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: Following a 10-catch, 99-yard performance in Week 1 against the Chargers, Brown was a non-factor in the pass-heavy Kansas City offense this season, totaling 536 yards and four touchdowns over 16 games. As the third or fourth option in the passing offense, Brown was treated as a rotational player even when the Chiefs struggled with wideout absences. After a highly disappointing two-year run with KC, Brown will likely play elsewhere in 2026. He’ll be a free agent this offseason.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.headline: Hollywood Brown caught 1-of-3 targets for seven yards in the Chiefs’ Week 17 loss to the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/marquise-b.analysis: Brown has caught more than three passes in two of his last 10 appearances. He has more than five grabs in just one game. That came all the way back in Week 1, when Rashee Rice was still suspended and Xavier Worthy left on the opening drive with a shoulder injury. Brown hasn’t been able to find a consistent role in the offense this year and even the loss of Rashee Rice over the past two weeks hasn’t changed that. He is not on the fantasy radar for Week 18.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Eagles signed RB Eljiah Mitchell to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: This time, they mean it. Mitchell has a decent chance to be elevated for Week 7 based on what we know today, which is that the Eagles waived Ian Wheeler from the practice squad and have only Saquon Barkley and Dameon Pierce on the active roster. This appears to be quite a fluid situation.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Eagles signed RB Elijah Mitchell.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: Mitchell now gets to be the “other” player who has been on New England and Philadelphia’s rosters this offseason. Released by the Patriots after the draft, Mitchell will try to catch on as a depth back behind Saquon Barkley.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Free agent RB Khalil Herbert attended Eagles rookie minicamp.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: Free agent RB Elijah Mitchell attended as well. Herbert appeared in three games with the Jets last year, rushing 16 times for 52 yards and earned three targets. Mitchell logged zero touches and earned one target, playing for the Patriots. The Eagles already have five running backs on the roster, so both players face uphill battles to snag a roster spot.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Patriots released RB Elijah Mitchell.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: It was almost a three-month stay on New England’s offseason roster. Seventh-rounder Jam Miller appears to have taken Mitchell’s spot on the depth chart, though Terrell Jennings is likely the third back in the pecking order behind Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Patriots signed RB Elijah Mitchell to a reserve-future contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: Mitchell played just one game with the Chiefs in 2025 before being released in December. He ended the season on the Patriots’ practice squad and the team has decided to bring him back for the offseason. Mitchell rushed for 963 yards and five touchdowns as a rookie with the 49ers but has struggled to find a role since. Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson headline the Pats’ backfield, but Mitchell will get a chance to compete for a depth role this offseason.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Patriots signed RB Elijah Mitchell to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: The signing doesn’t seem like great news for TreVeyon Henderson (concussion) in Week 17. Mitchell had been with the Chiefs all year and was cast aside for Dameon Pierce last week in what we’d call a “mercy” waiver. It’s possible he’ll be elevated for Week 17 if Henderson isn’t able to go.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Chiefs signed RB Dameon Pierce to the active roster.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: The team waived running back Elijah Mitchell in an associated move. Mitchell had been active in only once game this season, whereas Pierce can contribute to special teams on game day. The Chiefs enter “evaluation mode” for the first time in over a decade after being eliminated from postseason contention in Week 15.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Chiefs declared RG Trey Smith, TE Noah Gray, S Chris Roland-Wallace, RB Elijah Mitchell, WR Jalen Royals, OT Esa Pole and CB Kristian Fulton inactive for Week 13 against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: Losing Smith for this one is unfortunate. The capable pass blocker will be missed against an ascending Cowboys pass-rush unit. Both Mitchell and Royals are healthy scratches. Gray was unable to practice this week, due to a concussion. This matchup should produce a high-scoring game environment.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Chiefs declared CB Kristian Fulton, RB Isiah Pacheco, WR Jalen Royals, TE Jared Wiley, RB Elijah Mitchell, OT Josh Simmons, and OL CJ Hanson inactive for Week 9 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: Even with Isiah Pacheco (knee) out, the Chiefs are not going to have Mitchell active, which means Clyde Edwards-Helaire has surpassed him on the depth chart. Simmons remains out due to unclear personal reasons.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.headline: Chiefs ruled out RB Isiah Pacheco (knee) for Week 9 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/elijah-mit.analysis: Pacheco’s absence is expected. The Chiefs’ starting running back sprained an MCL in Week 8 against the Commanders and was deemed “week-to-week” on Tuesday after undergoing further testing. Pacheco’s sidelining reduces the backfield to a two-player committee, led by RB Kareem Hunt, who will likely remain on the field for short-yardage situations, including at the goal line. Rookie RB Brashard Smith will continue functioning as a featured receiver and part-time rusher. Hunt is a touchdown-dependent RB2 while Smith is a high-upside FLEX against a poor Bills’ run defense that just lost stud DT Ed Oliver (biceps) for the year. Backup RB Elijah Mitchell can be stashed in very deep leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Eagles waived RB Jaydon Blue.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: They tacked on a waived/injured listing for Carson Steele, leaving the backfield with just Saquon Barkley and Dameon Pierce on the active roster. Blue did not officially get into a game with the Eagles after signing at the end of August. He’ll look to catch on elsewhere.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Carson Steele left Week 6 against the Panthers with a shoulder injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Steele caught a screen pass in the flats and lowered his head to try and run over the defender. He came up holding his shoulder and had to have the shoulder immobilized as he walked into the locker room with his pads off. It had the look of a dislocation, which would mean Dameon Pierce and Jaydon Blue are the only two healthy running backs for the Eagles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Week 6 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: It was pretty clear that this was where things were headed when Barkley was unable to practice on Wednesday and Thursday. We do not yet know Barkley’s official Friday practice participation level, but he was not seen practicing during the portion of practice open to the media. Dameon Pierce, Carson Steele and practice squad player Jaydon Blue will likely split touches this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Barkley is firmly on the wrong side of questionable for his team’s Week 6 game against the Panthers, potentially leaving Dameon Pierce, Carson Steele and practice squad player Jaydon Blue to split touches. Hopefully, reports clarify whether Pierce would handle a sizable workload as the de facto starter.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Tank Bigsby will have core muscle surgery and be placed on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Rapoport reports there are hopes that Bigsby will be back “in six weeks or shorter.” The 24-year-old back will be required to miss at least four games now that he’s headed for an IR stint. With Saquon Barkley (hamstring) also at risk of missing at least one game, third-string RB Will Shipley could be in line for a busy day in Week 5 against the Jaguars. Shipley rushed six times for 23 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams, but could be a sneaky option in PPR leagues given his pass-catching profile during his days at Clemson, when he caught 85 passes over three seasons. It also wouldn’t be surprising if Dameon Pierce or Jaydon Blue were promoted off the practice squad and saw early down touches while Shipley serves in more of a third-down role. There’s a lot to figure out here over the next few days.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports that the Cowboys “are bracing for an extended absence” after RB Malik Davis suffered a hip injury on Friday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Regarding Davis’ injury, Fowler’s source said simply, “it’s bad.” The Cowboys’ No. 2 running back is undergoing further testing, but we expect them to place him on injured reserve before long. The Cowboys waived RB Jaydon Blue and RB Phil Mafah last month. Blue has since signed with the Eagles’ practice squad. The Cowboys have RB Emari Demercado on the active roster behind RB Javonte Williams. Currently, only RB Israel Abanikanda is on the practice squad in Dallas.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Blue was waived by the Cowboys and went unclaimed, and the 2025 fifth-round pick will remain in the NFC East. He’ll begin the campaign behind Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley as backups to Saquon Barkley, but some strong performances in practice could give the 22-year-old a chance to receive touches in 2026.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Former Cowboys RB Jaydon Blue goes unclaimed on waivers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Blue now becomes a free agent and can be signed by any running back-needy team, including the ability to sign onto the Dallas practice squad. It has been quite the fall from grace for Blue over the previous 24 hours, seemingly going from the favorite for backup duties for the Cowboys to without a home. It is also noteworthy that only one running back was claimed during the waiver period, veteran Emari Demercado, by this same Cowboys team. Blue appears to have lost all fantasy value and faces an uphill battle for a meaningful role in his sophomore campaign.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Cowboys waived RB Jaydon Blue.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Well this one is going to leave a mark. 2025 fifth-rounder Blue was a summer ’25 fantasy creation the Cowboys never seemed to get behind, confirming as much when they made him a Week 1 healthy scratch. That set the tone for a bitterly disappointing rookie year that featured just 39 touches. This offseason seemed to be different, however, with head coach Brian Schottenheimer spending the spring dishing out over-the-top positive quotes on his second-year back. The praise again died down during training camp, but Blue showed well in his preseason action. Just apparently nowhere close to well enough to beat out survivor veteran Malik Davis for No. 2 status behind Javonte Williams. Blue is still only 22 years old, but his back-to-back failures to earn pass-catching duties in a backfield that could really use such a player is an ominous sign for his NFL future. He’s now a tenuous hold in dynasty leagues despite his youth and past high expectations. All of that being said, it is possible once the cut-down dust settles that either Blue or fellow waived sophomore Phil Mafah end up back on the Cowboys’ 53-man roster.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Cowboys RB Malik Davis was held out with the starters in Friday’s preseason game against the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Davis appears to have secured a roster spot, but we won’t know for sure until Sunday. The broadcast initially referred to him as the starter, but it was instead RB Phil Mafah who took the field. Mafah dominated backfield touches throughout the first half, repeatedly running into Saints defenders on runs up the middle. He was spelled by RB Israel Abanikanda. Cowboys RB Jaydon Blue does not seem to be playing this evening. Last Sunday, The Athletic’s Jon Machota predicted Blue would seize the No. 2 running back job from Davis in-season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Rams signed K Brandon McManus to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: With Blake Grupe done for the season with a torn ACL, the Rams worked out McManus and Matt Prater before agreeing to terms with McManus. The 35-year-old was released by the Packers after they drafted Trey Smack in the sixth round and hasn’t had any documented interest since then. He’ll be a reasonable one-kicker league play with the Rams.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Packers released K Brandon McManus.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: If two missed field goals and a missed extra point in last season’s Wild Card round loss to the Bears didn’t spell McManus’ impending exit, then the selection of Florida kicker Trey Smack in the sixth round of this year’s draft almost certainly did. McManus, 34, converted 24-of-30 field goals during the regular season in 2025, but struggled on distances of 40-plus yards, going 6-for-12 from that range. The decision to release McManus will carry a dead cap hit just north of $4.3 million for the Packers in 2026 and a dead cap hit of $1.66 million in 2027. McManus will likely catch on with another team before training camp and get a chance to compete for a starting job for the upcoming season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Brandon McManus missed both field goal attempts while making 3-of-4 extra points in the Packers’ Wild Card Round loss to the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: McManus missed two critical kicks; an extra-point that would have put the Packers up by 13 with two minutes left, and a field goal that would have extended the Green Bay lead to six. The 34-year-old made 24-of-30 field goals in 2025, but he went just 6-for-12 on kicks beyond 40 yards. He is signed through 2027, but there’s no guarantee that McManus will be back in Green Bay in 2026.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Brandon McManus went 3-for-3 on his field goal attempts in Week 16’s loss to the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: McManus also converted on his only extra point of the evening. The veteran kicker nailed field goals from 26, 22, and 28 yards in this one, helping hold off the Bears just long enough for the Packers to build a 16-6 lead, but that evaporated in the final minutes of the fourth quarter. McManus has now converted on 22 of his 28 field goal attempts this season and will be a solid Week 17 option against the Ravens.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Packers waived K Lucas Havrisik.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: In three games with the Packers this season, Havrisik converted 4-of-4 field goals and 7-of-9 extra point attempts. His services are no longer needed with K Brandon McManus (quad) off the injury report. The Packers also signed WR Will Sheppard to the active roster and elevated LB Jamon Johnson and S Jaylin Simpson from the practice squad.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Packers K Brandon McManus is inactive for Week 11 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: 34-year-old McManus is missing too much time with injury for a kicker this season. Lucas Havrisik will handle kicking duties today in New York. He’s a mediocre fantasy option with the Pack’s offense really going through it right now.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Packers LB Quay Walker (calf) is active for Week 9 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: Walker was a surprise DNP in the middle of the week because of the calf injury. He returned for a limited session on Friday before being listed as questionable. Brandon McManus was also questionable and is active. Inactive for the Packers are WR Dontayvion Wicks, K Lucas Havrisik, OG Jacob Monk, OT Donovan Jennings, DL Lukas Van Ness, and DL Warren Brinson.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Brandon McManus K Brandon McManus (right quad) is questionable to play in Week 9 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: McManus played through the questionable tag last week, converting 3-of-3 extra point attempts and 2-of-4 field goals. He is too unreliable, playing through injury, to be started at this time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Packers K Brandon McManus (quad) is questionable for Green Bay’s Week 8 game against the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: McManus practiced in a limited setting on Thursday and Friday. If he’s not able to go in Week 8, Lucas Havrisik would take the reins as Green Bay’s kicker again.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.headline: Packers K Brandon McManus (quad) is inactive for Week 7 against the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/brandon-mc.analysis: Also inactive for the Packers are RB Pierre Strong Jr., G Donovan Jennings, T Anthony Belton, TE Ben Sims, DL Lukas Van Ness, and DL Devonte Wyatt. McManus will miss another game due to his quad issue, meaning Lucas Havrisik will kick for Green Bay against the Cardinals. Strong was elevated from the practice squad, but with Josh Jacobs (calf/illness) active, he is inactive this week. Meanwhile, Van Ness will miss this game due to a foot issue that kept him out of practice all week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: Cowboys signed Kyle Trask to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: There’s a new third-string sheriff in town after Joe Milton was signed away by the Eagles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: Chargers worked out free agent WR JuJu Smith-Schuster on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: Smith-Schuster is touring wide receiver-needy teams, working out with the Chargers Monday after visiting the Vikings on Monday. Several other names also worked out for the Chargers, including former 49ers WR Ronnie Bell and quarterbacks Kyle Trask and Jake Browning. With Trey Lance on injured reserve and several Chargers receivers dealing with injuries, the Chargers are looking for reinforcements.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: Panthers released QB Kyle Trask.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: He’ll remain an emergency quarterback option for the team per Jeremy Fowler, which is a nice way of saying he’s not making the practice squad either. The 28-year-old former second-round pick will look for work elsewhere.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: Panthers are expected to sign veteran free agent QB Kyle Trask.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: The move makes sense considering Trask served as the backup quarterback in Tampa under Dave Canales. Trask remains unlikely to crack camp as a member of the 53-man roster, most likely simply providing additional depth at the position through the end of camp. The move that makes the most procedural sense would be to retain undrafted free agent Haynes King on the practice squad while Kenny Pickett serves as the primary backup to Bryce Young.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: Free agent quarterback Kyle Trask will attend the Saints’ rookie minicamp.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: Per NewOrleans.Football’s Nick Underhill, Easton Stick will also have a tryout during mincamp. Trask re-signed with the Bucs last offseason but failed to crack the roster at the end of training camp. He later joined the Falcons’ practice squad. The Saints currently have Spencer Rattler and Zach Wilson as options to back up Tyler Shough.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: Free agent quarterbacks Kyle Trask, Tanner Mordecai, Jarren Hall, and Jeff Driskel visited with the Colts on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: None of the four of them signed yet, so it’s possible the Colts are just doing some homework on a potential Anthony Richardson replacement at backup quarterback rather than settling for this pool of candidates. Trask hadn’t had a workout since being released by the Bucs at last cuts.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports that the Buccaneers are releasing QB Kyle Trask.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: The Buccaneers will work out an injury settlement for Trask, as he’s currently dealing with a shoulder issue. A second-round pick for some reason in 2021, Trask has been the backup quarterback for the Bucs over the last four seasons, but that honor will now apparently go to Teddy Bridgewater. Trask is likely a practice squad player for a new organization in the coming days.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: Buccaneers re-signed QB Kyle Trask to a one-year, $2.787 million contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: Trask was initially drafted in the second round of the 2021 draft, spending the last four years as the Buccaneers’ backup quarterback. He’s only thrown 11 passes in the NFL, completing four of them for 28 yards. Trask will backup Baker Mayfield again for 2025.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: Baker Mayfield returned to Week 13 against the Panthers after suffering an apparent ankle injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: Mayfield was sacked on consecutive plays and was brutally twisted up and taken down on the second one. After the second sack, Mayfield’s right ankle was accidentally stepped on by Jadeveon Clowney, slamming the outer side of Mayfield’s right ankle down to the ground, pinned underneath Clowney’s body weight. Update: Mayfield returned to play but immediately threw an interception.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.headline: Baker Mayfield (ribs) did not practice Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kyle-trask.analysis: Kyle Trask is expected to get most of the Bucs’ first-team reps in practice this week with Mayfield struggling through a rib injury he picked up in last week’s loss to the Saints. Tampa head coach Todd Bowles said he expects Mayfield to play in the team’s critical Week 18 game against the Panthers. Mayfield’s Friday practice status will likely dictate whether he will be active against Carolina. “I’ll do everything I can to be out there,” Mayfield said Wednesday. “That’s for sure. Division on the line. Playoff hopes on the line. Going back to Carolina? Yeah, I’ll do everything. I can.” Mayfield has the NFL’s sixth highest drop back EPA this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.headline: Colts signed WR Mecole Hardman to their practice squad.
Bills released WR Mecole Hardman.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.analysis: Hardman’s release was first reported by ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler. A seven-year NFL veteran, Hardman spent most of his career with the Chiefs, where he helped Kansas City win three Super Bowls. Last year he appeared in only two games with the Bills and dropped passes were an issue in training camp and preseason this year. Hardman will head to the open market where he could be a fit for another team looking for wide receiver depth. Also released/waived were OLB Cade Denhoff, CB Jordan Dunbar, G Bruno Fina, ILB Theron Gaines, C Sincere Haynesworth, DL Zion Logue, CB D.J. Miller, S Wande Owens, WR Dante Pettis, LB Otis Reese IV, WR Quentin Skinner, and TE Shane Zylstra.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.headline: Mecole Hardman caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards and a touchdown in the Bills’ AFC Divisional Round loss to the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.analysis: Hardman was elevated from the practice squad with both Gabe Davis and Tyrell Shavers suffering season-ending ACL injuries. His touchdown was the first score of the game for the Bills, but he also dropped a catch that would have kept Buffalo’s drive alive at the end of the fourth quarter. Hardman had no catches on just one target during the regular season as he bounced around a few practice squads. He’ll probably need to settle for a practice squad spot in 2026 as well.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.headline: Bills activated DT Ed Oliver (biceps) from injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.analysis: Oliver and WR Curtis Samuel (elbow/neck) are both being activated today. Samuel cannot reasonably be viewed as a reliable contributor, but the Bills’ wide receiver room is thin. Oliver’s return should have a larger impact on the game. Despite missing much of the season, he ties for third on the team with three sacks. The Bills are also elevating WR Mecole Hardman and RB Frank Gore Jr. from the practice squad.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.headline: Bills placed WR Mecole Hardman on injured reserve with a calf injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.analysis: Hardman will now miss at least four games. He does not need to be rostered in any format. The Bills also elevated WR Gabe Davis from the practice squad to the active roster for tonight’s game against the Texans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.headline: Curtis Samuel (neck/elbow) will not play in Week 12 against the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.analysis: Mecole Hardman will also be sidelined for this game. Josh Palmer should be locked in as the Bills’ No. 2 receiver for Week 12. Gabe Davis and Tyrell Shavers will also be in the mix for routes.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.headline: Bills WR Curtis Samuel (elbow/neck) will not practice on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.analysis: Neither will Mecole Hardman (calf), and with Buffalo’s wideout depth in trouble for Week 12, it looks like the sort of perfect storm to get Keon Coleman active again for Thursday night.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.headline: Mecole Hardman was ruled out for the remainder of Week 11 with a calf injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.analysis: Hardman was signed to Buffalo’s practice squad this week and then signed to the active roster on Saturday night. His Bills career began with an electric 61-yard kickoff return. He later fumbled on a punt return where he should have called a fair catch. That was his last play of the game, but the Bills ruled him out with a calf injury. It does make you wonder how long his Bills tenure will last.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.headline: Bills signed WR Mecole Hardman from the practice squad to the active roster.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.analysis: In order to make room on the active roster, the Bills released KR/PR Brandon Codrington which seems to signal that Hardman will primarily be used as a return man in Buffalo. The Bills could also use Hardman on som gadget routes but they have Elijah Moore and Curtis Samuel in that role as well. For now, Hardman remains off fantasy radars.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.headline: Bills head coach Sean McDermott said he’s “excited” about WR Mecole Hardman.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/mecole-har.analysis: McDermott complimented the “flexibility” Hardman brings to the offense. The Bills signed Hardman to their practice squad on Tuesday. The longtime Chiefs gadget player and kicker returner could suit up for the Bills as soon as Week 11 against the Bucs. He had just 26 receptions over his past final two seasons with the Chiefs and hasn’t scored a regular season touchdown since 2022. Hardman will likely be a situational player in the run-heavy Buffalo offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Terry McLaurin (knee) tore his patellar tendon and will miss the rest of the season.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: It’s another rough blow for Washington’s No. 1 wideout, who will now have missed most of the last two seasons with injuries with the book closed on a 15-catch, 230-yard 2026 season in just five games. Entering his age-32 season in 2027, McLaurin will be a release or restructure candidate with a $34 million cap hit. The Commanders could save $16 million by releasing him without getting into post-June 1 antics. In the short term fantasy calculus, Stefon Diggs will slide in as Washington’s No. 1 receiver and Chig Okonkwo will also get a boost. Antonio Williams figures to see more snaps going forward as well.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: ESPN’s John Keim reports Terry McLaurin’s knee injury is considered “significant.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: Washington head coach Dan Quinn said after the team’s Monday night loss to the 49ers that there was “fear” McLaurin could be lost for the long-term after going down with a non-contact injury and was carted to the locker room. McLaurin has functioned as the team’s lone downfield threat for much of the season, and could be replaced with Treylon Burks, who on Monday night caught four balls for 66 yards before sustaining a late-game injury. Antonio Williams and Dyami Brown could also see an increase in routes and targets if McLaurin is sidelined for a while. Look for Chig Okonkwo to see an uptick in targets too. Okonkwo had seven grabs for 69 yards against the Niners.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: Sports Illustrated’s John Shipley believes it could make long-term sense for the Commanders to acquire Brian Thomas, Jr.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: Shipley mentions the Commanders and Rams as wideout-desperate teams who might be interested in trading for Thomas before the NFL’s trade deadline. The Jaguars have apparently soured on the one-time burgeoning star in recent weeks; against the Texans in Week 6, Thomas ran a pass route on just 28 percent of the Jags’ drop backs and saw two targets. The Commanders, meanwhile, lost Terry McLaurin to a potentially long-term knee injury on Monday night. Thomas, per Shipley, “is not a trade that would make a ton of sense for a Commanders team that might be losing a ton of games and needs their picks to rebuild ... but it would make sense for a general manager who needs to keep his job to give his quarterback a familiar and talented target. Daniels was Thomas’ quarterback during their final seasons at LSU, and the connection between the two could go a long-way toward solving some of Washington’s long-term issues at the wide receiver position.” BTJ’s fantasy prospects would get a big boost if he were to land in Washington in the coming weeks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: Terry McLaurin (knee) was carted to the locker room in the first quarter of Week 6 against the 49ers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: The mechanism of the injury did not look promising, with the veteran receiver buckling to the turf in non-contact fashion. It’s a devastating development for the 31-year-old receiver in what was the first game since Week 1 where Jayden Daniels, McLaurin, and Stefon Diggs were healthy together. Expect further updates from the team as the game progresses, but it certainly appears as if McLaurin’s season could be in jeopardy. McLaurin caught his only target for 27 yards prior to departing. Rookie Antonio Williams and Treylon Burks are the most likely fill-ins for the remainder of the game, and, potentially, the season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: Terry McLaurin (hamstring/rest) did not practice on Friday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: The Commanders added a “rest” designation to McLaurin’s report, so fantasy managers should not be alarmed by today’s absence. The veteran wide receiver played through the injury last week and should be expected to do so again this week. McLaurin is a WR2 against the 49ers in Week 6’s Monday Night Football game.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was limited on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: McLaurin posted a 4/62 receiving line, playing through this hamstring injury in Week 5 against the Giants. Kicking off the week with a limited session is a great sign for his Week 6 availability and overall health. Expect McLaurin to be even more involved against the 49ers on Monday night.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) did not practice Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said he is hopeful Diggs will get some practice reps in later this week. Diggs missed Week 5 with the hamstring issue, and a DNP today puts him on the wrong side of questionable for Week 6, even if Quinn remains optimistic. Terry McLaurin and Chig Okonkwo led the team in receiving last week. McLaurin should pull away from Okonkwo as he puts more time between himself and the hamstring injury that previously knocked him out for a week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: Terry McLaurin caught 4-of-4 targets for 62 yards in the Commanders’ Week 5 tie with the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: It was reported before the game that McLaurin would not be a full go after he was limited in practice all week with a hamstring injury. While McLaurin would finish the game with the third-most snaps played by any Commanders receiver, his 28 routes run were tied for the most of any player on the team. McLaurin converted all four of his targets into receptions on Sunday, with his biggest gain coming on a 22-yard reception in overtime that looked to be the start of an eventual game-winning drive for Washington. McLaurin’s 62 receiving yards led all of Washington’s pass-catchers in this one, and he has now totaled 50 or more yards in three straight games. If Stefon Diggs, who missed this week’s game (hamstring) is able to suit up next week against the 49ers, McLaurin will profile as a fringe WR2/WR3.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is active for Week 5 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: While it’s good news that McLaurin is active, NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reported earlier that he is “likely not a full go” for Sunday’s game. To make matters worse, the Commanders and Giants are expected to battle it out in soggy conditions all afternoon, which could further limit McLaurin’s upside in this one. Fantasy managers hoping to play him need to temper expectations given his status and the game’s conditions, and shouldn’t consider McLaurin as anything more than a mid-to-low-end WR3. The Commanders announced WR Stefon Diggs (hamstring), QB Marcus Mariota (knee), S Tyler Owens (hamstring), S Nick Cross (illness), S Percy Butler (hamstring), OG Tanoa Togiai, and DE Charles Omenihu (groin/ankle) are inactive for Week 5.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.headline: NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reports Terry McLaurin is a “true game-time decision” for Week 5 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/terry-mcla.analysis: McLaurin is listed as questionable for Week 5 after getting in a single limited practice on Friday. Even if he does play, McLaurin will likely be on a pitch count. Stefon Diggs has already been ruled out with a hamstring issue of his own. Rookie Antonio Williams will be asked to step up whether or not McLaurin is active.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: Titans released DT Jordan Elliott.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: Elliott, per a team statement, was involved in what the team cryptically refers to as “an incident at our team facility” on October 15. He was a healthy scratch this weekend and was let go on Tuesday after signing a two-year contract this offseason. The club has refused further comment.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: Titans agreed to terms with DL Jordan Elliott, formerly of the 49ers, on a two-year, $8.5 million contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: Elliott played under new Titans head coach Robert Saleh with the 49ers and should work into the defensive rotation alongside Jermaine Johnson, Jeffery Simmons, and John Franklin-Myers. His addition now brings the total of new faces along the defensive line to three for a Titans franchise looking to turn over a new stone moving forward.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: 49ers ruled out EDGE Bryce Huff (hamstring) in Week 9 against the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: The 49ers also ruled out EDGE Yetur Gross-Matos (hamstring) and C Jake Brendel (hamstring), while labeling DT Jordan Elliott (ankle/personal matter), LB Dee Winters (knee), DL Sam Okuayinonu (ankle), OG Ben Bartch (ankle) and OL Spencer Burford (knee) questionable for Week 9. The 49ers’ defense is officially one to target for fantasy purposes and their poor health should also reinforce the offense’s passing volume.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: 49ers DT Jordan Elliott (ankle) left San Francisco’s Week 8 game against the Texans and was ruled out.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: The 49ers continue to rack up injuries on defense. Elliott played 18 snaps before being ruled out, and Alfred Collins will assume a bigger role going forward with Elliott out.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: 49ers ruled out Nick Bosa (hip/obliques) for Week 13 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: Bosa’s dual-oblique/hip injury will sideline him again and the defensive line will also notably be without starting DT Jordan Elliott (concussion), leaving the 49ers defensive-right side of the field awfully short-staffed. Josh Allen’s blindside should be kept clean and the run game will likely be able to impose its will easily, running off of left tackle Dion Dawkins. CB Deommodore Lenoir (knee) is out though CB Charvarius Ward (personal) will return after a three-game absence.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: 49ers DT Jordan Elliott (knee) exited Week 4 against the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: Elliott serves as DT Javon Hargrave’s (injured reserve) primary backup so the defensive interior is now worryingly short-staffed. Elliott exhibited a clear limp as he walked off the field under his own power. He was later ruled out.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: 49ers and DT Jordan Elliott agreed to a two-year, $10 million contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: Elliott spent the last two seasons starting on the Browns’ defensive line. Starting in 31 of 34 possible games over that span, Elliott has totaled 57 tackles and 4.5 sacks over the last two years while also notching eight TFLs. While the counting numbers aren’t bad, Elliott has consistently graded on the lower end of PFF’s defensive line grades for his career and has been credited with missing 11 percent of his tackle attempts. Despite playing in all 17 games last season, Elliott played on just 440 snaps — the fewest since his rookie season. With Arik Armstead expected to be released, Elliott could be tasked with replacing at least part of what Armstead has offered the 49ers over his nine-year career.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: Browns DL coach Chris Kiffin says of DT Jordan Elliott: “He’s bigger, faster, stronger. He put in the work from the time the season was over. So he looks different out here than he ever has.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: It wouldn’t be an offseason Sunday without at least one Best Shape Of His Life blurb. Mary Kay Cabot believes that if Elliott capitalizes on this momentum, he’ll probably be starting inside for the Browns. Defensive tackle is one of the few weak points of this defense. They could desperately use some good run defenders. Elliott could be one of them.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: Browns signed third-round DT Jordan Elliott to a four-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: Elliott was a top-25 player on some boards. Elliott (6’4/302) went to Texas as a top-150 high school recruit but transferred to Missouri where he started two seasons. He transformed his body going into his redshirt junior season, which led to more twitch off the line of scrimmage and more disruption with his pass rushing moves. His trimmed down build didn’t affect his play strength either. He remained strong against the run and eventually earned second-team Associated Press All-American after compiling 31 tackles, 8.5 TFLs, and 2.5 sacks. A 65th percentile Adjusted SPARQ athlete, Elliott offers quality starter potential at multiple interior positions, especially if he continues reshaping his physical build.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.headline: Browns selected Missouri DT Jordan Elliott with the No. 88 overall pick in the 2020 NFL Draft.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jordan-ell.analysis: Elliott was a top-25 player on some boards. Elliott (6’4/302) went to Texas as a top-150 high school recruit but transferred to Missouri where he started two seasons. He transformed his body going into his redshirt junior season, which led to more twitch off the line of scrimmage and more disruption with his pass rushing moves. His trimmed down build didn’t affect his play strength either. He remained strong against the run and eventually earned second-team Associated Press All-American after compiling 31 tackles, 8.5 TFLs, and 2.5 sacks. A 65th percentile Adjusted SPARQ athlete, Elliott offers quality starter potential at multiple interior positions, especially if he continues reshaping his physical build.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/catherine-.headline: The Athletic’s Jourdan Rodrigue believes Browns assistant GM and VP of football operations Catherine Hickman may be a name to watch in Indianapolis’ GM search.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/catherine-.analysis: Rodrigue reports that Browns GM Andrew Berry’s endorsement of a candidate “may hold some weight” for Colts owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon as he was “instructive” to Irsay-Gordon’s football development. Thus, two of the top names on Rodrigue’s list of candidates for the Colts GM job are Hickman and the Browns other assistant GM/VP of football operations, Glenn Cook. She also mentions Adam Berry — Eagles assistant GM and twin brother of Andrew — and Eagles VP of football operations Alan Wolking, among others.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/catherine-.headline: Browns hired Eagles VP of football operations Catherine Raiche as assistant general manager and VP of football operations.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/catherine-.analysis: Raiche has broken her own record for second highest-ranking female personnel executive in the history of the league. Raiche interviewed for the Vikings and Bears’ general manager vacancies in January. Raiche comes from an unorthodox background as a Canadian who cut her teeth in the CFL. It is a fraught time in the Browns’ front office with the Deshaun Watson off-the-field storm clouds refusing to dissipate.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/catherine-.headline: The Vikings have requested permission to interview Eagles VP of football operations Catherine Raiche for their general manager vacancy.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/catherine-.analysis: In the Eagles’ front office since 2019, Raiche was promoted to her current position just last year. Only 32 years old, Raiche is a Canadian who got her start in the CFL before a brief stop in the XFL. She then arrived in Philadelphia. She is believed to be the first woman to interview for an NFL general manager job, though she would not be the first female GM. Susan Tose Spencer served in the role for the Eagles in the early ‘80s after being given the job by her father, the team owner. Also a lawyer, Raiche would bring a number of unique perspectives to a Vikings front office that has not had a new leader since 2006.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: Free agent K Justin Tucker visited the Dolphins on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: Since his 10-game suspension for violating the league’s personal conduct policy over sexual misconduct allegations, Tucker has tried out for the Saints, Colts, Jets, and now Dolphins over the past two seasons. He lost out to Zane Gonzalez for this job despite what, per Aaron Wilson, was an impressive workout.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: Jets hosted Justin Tucker for a workout.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero notes that the Jets hosted a group workout and are exploring all options at kicker. They already claimed Blake Grupe and re-signed Jason Sanders to their practice squad this week. Tucker worked out for multiple teams last year after serving a 10-game suspension for violating the team’s personal conduct policy. He was never signed and hasn’t kicked in a game since the 2024 season, which was the worst of his career by far. Tucker made just 73.3 percent of his field goal tries.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: Free agent K Justin Tucker visited with the Colts on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: We can see why the Colts wouldn’t have wanted that to get out ahead of signing Blake Grupe. Still, this is two teams in two weeks that have kicked the tires on Tucker despite his 10-game suspension over sexual misconduct allegations. He’s probably going to continue to get work on the kicker tryout circuit. The Colts also brought in Maddux Trujillo.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reports the Saints will host free agent K Justin Tucker for a tryout this week.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: Tucker’s 10-game suspension for violating the league’s personal conduct policy due to his involvement in sexually inappropriate behavior was lifted two weeks ago. Now, the 36-year-old kicker will have a chance to try out for the Saints, who are looking for a potential upgrade over Blake Grupe after his two missed field goals in Week 12’s loss to the Falcons. Tucker had his worst season as a pro in 2024, converting on a career-low 73.3 percent of his field goal attempts while going 11-for-19 from 40-plus yards. Among other participants in the tryout will be Cade York, who last kicked for the Commanders in 2024, going 0-for-2 on his attempts.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: The NFL suspended free agent K Justin Tucker without pay for the first 10 weeks of the 2025 regular season for violating the league’s personal conduct policy.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: Tucker was released by the Ravens in early May, roughly three months after 16 massage therapists accused Tucker of sexual misconduct. The suspension is the culmination of a multi-month investigation conducted by the NFL. Per ESPN’s Jamison Hensley, Tucker may still sign with a team and “attend training camp and play in preseason games before the suspension starts” on August 26. He will be eligible for reinstatement on Tuesday, November 11.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: Ravens released K Justin Tucker.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: The writing was on the wall after the draft, where Baltimore drafted rookie kicker Tyler Loop as Tucker’s replacement. Tucker has spent most of the late season and offseason dealing with sexual misconduct allegations from massage therapists in Baltimore-area spas, and had by far the worst season of his career in 2024, making 73.3 percent of his 30 field-goal attempts. The Ravens stood by him throughout the process and framed moving on from him as a “football decision” in a statement, but it’s hard to believe they would have moved on from him if not for the allegations. Tucker will likely have to clear his name, as Brandon McManus did this past offseason, before he gets another NFL chance. The NFL’s investigation into Tucker’s behavior is, per CBS’ Jonathan Jones, still “under review.”

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: Ravens head coach John Harbaugh told reporters that personnel decisions regarding the kicker position “will be based on football.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: Reporters asked Harbaugh about the NFL’s open investigation into Justin Tucker’s 16 sexual assault allegations, and whether the Ravens might move on from Tucker with sixth-round rookie K Tyler Loop now in the fold. Harbaugh answered by saying the Ravens’ organization does not know “anything” about the investigation and has not been given any information by the league. Per Harbaugh, “every decision” the Ravens make must therefore “be based on football,” citing things like practice performance, draft capital and salary cap implications as critical factors. Loop promisingly converted 45-of-47 field goals attempted from 0-to-39 yards out in his college career.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: ESPN’s Jamison Hensley reports the Ravens have “invested countless hours” into scouting incoming rookie kickers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: Ravens senior special teams coach Randy Brown has traveled across the country in recent weeks scouting incoming kickers as Justin Tucker’s 2025 status remains in question. Sixteen massage therapists from Baltimore-area spas have accused Tucker of sexual misconduct. Tucker, 35, has denied the allegations as the league investigates. “Obviously, there are a lot of layers to that whole conversation, but it’s something we would have to do no matter what,” head coach John Harbaugh said. “At this point in time, you have to look. You always have to do your due diligence, so we will be prepared to do that on draft day if we feel like we need to and if the right guy is there.” The Ravens are the only team in the NFL to never take a kicker in the draft. That could change this year: The team is holding a private workout for Florida State’s Ryan Fitzgerald, who made all 13 of this field goal attempts last season and is widely expected to be the first kicker off the draft board.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: Ravens HC John Harbaugh said “it’s something we have to do, no matter what, at this point in time,” when asked about the possibility of drafting a kicker.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: It goes without saying that Justin Tucker’s tenure with the Ravens is likely trending toward an end as the Ravens and the league continue to investigate the sexual misconduct allegations that have followed the veteran kicker since the season’s end. Tucker converting on a career-low 73.3 percent of his field goal attempts last season likely isn’t helping his case, either. This is the strongest any member of the Ravens organization has sounded so far about moving on from Tucker, as the organizational message has more often been one of letting the league’s investigation play out. Saying “no matter what” sure paints a picture of some unsavory results in that investigation.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.headline: Ravens president Sashi Brown said “that the team won’t make a determination on kicker Justin Tucker’s future with the team until the NFL has finished its investigation.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/justin-tuc.analysis: The Ravens are holding firm with the plans they outlined roughly one month ago. Tucker is being investigated for sexual misconduct allegations made by 16 women. The team has reportedly received “periodic updates” from the league, but the investigation is evidently still ongoing. Per ESPN’s Jamison Hensley, Ravens head coach John Harbaugh and general manager Eric DeCosta acknowledged that the team “is looking at kickers in the draft.”

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.headline: Giants released Najee Harris.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.analysis: The move comes a couple days after Harris criticized the New York coaching staff for its handling of the backfield touch distribution. “It’s hard to get into a rhythm with one or two plays...if you’re getting a play here and then get taken out for a series, there’s nothing you could do,” Harris said after the Giants’ Week 6 loss to the Saints. “I’ve never been through none of this before.” With Harris gone, Cam Skattebo could get another chance to see increased playing time after being all but benched last week. Tyrone Tracy, who led the team in rushing attempts against New Orleans, could be the de facto lead back for now.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.headline: Giants coach John Harbaugh, asked about the running back room, said carries are “earned” and told his players to “do something” in their opportunities and more will come.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.analysis: Tyrone Tracy appeared to do the most with his opportunities last week, scoring the game’s only two touchdowns. Najee Harris was bottled up and Cam Skattebo was soft benched while Devin Singletary led the team in snaps while they were in comeback mode for most of the second half. By the letter of what he’s offering here, Tracy is probably the player who should get the majority of the snaps against the Texans. In actuality, we have no idea what will happen here and this quote doesn’t really help us. “I don’t like (rotating backs) either,” Harbaugh said per The Athletic’s Dan Duggan after the game. “One of those guys needs to step up. Somebody needs to step up and be the back. And none of those guys have done that yet.” We suspect we’ll be diving beat writer opinions ahead of Sunday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.headline: Najee Harris rushed four times for two yards in the Giants’ Week 6 loss to the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.analysis: Harris started the game for the Giants after it was reported Cam Skatteboo would be downgraded after his fumble issues. Fantasy managers that picked up Harris to start or stash will be immensely disappointed to see four carries and 11 snaps on the day. A pass-heavy game script played a role in that, but he totaled just two yards and has been a largely ineffective runner this season. Harris can remain off fantasy rosters heading into Week 7 against the Texans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports Najee Harris is “set to start” for the Giants in Week 6 against the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.analysis: Fowler was adding to a report from Jordan Raanan , who said Harris is “likely to have a larger role with Cam Skattebo downgraded but still part of the mix after the fumbles.” Skattebo has indeed struggled with fumbles, putting the ball on the ground four times this year. No running back has more fumbles, and Skattebo’s most recent blunder cost the Giants a shot at an overtime win versus the Commanders last week. They instead settled for a tie. Even if Skattebo winds up leading the team in carries this week, he was only valuable for fantasy managers because of his high-volume role. With that out the window, Skattebo is buried in the RB3 ranks for Week 6.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.headline: Giants coach John Harbaugh said “We’ll see. We’ll find out,” when asked if the Giants have reached the point where he’ll make adjustments due to the team’s fumbling issues.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.analysis: Giants beat writer Dan Duggan chimed in with “I would be very surprised if [Cam] Skattebo has the same RB1 workload on Sunday that he’s had in the first five games.” Skattebo has put the ball on the ground four times in the first five games. Najee Harris has one in 27 carries and Tyrone Tracy has added two. It sounds like Harris may start to be a significant thorn in the side of Skattebo-reliant managers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.headline: Najee Harris rushed nine times for 30 yards in the Giants’ Week 4 win over the Cardinals, also losing a fumble.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.analysis: Harris was playing Cam Skattebo to a usage standstill before his fourth quarter giveaway in a game where the G-Men were clinging to a 27-24 lead. He never touched the ball afterwards, going over 11 minutes without a handle as Skattebo saw seven touches during that timespan. That’s what a fumble benching looks like. Coach John Harbaugh will likely forgive and forget going into Week 5 against the Commanders, but not to the degree a timeshare starts developing. This might have been Harris’ one shot in that regard. Even with injuries mounting and bye weeks beginning, Harris is a tough stash in 12-team leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.headline: Najee Harri rushed nine times for 52 yards in the Giants’ Week 3 win over the Titans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.analysis: Devin Singletary was inactive this week and Tyrone Tracy only touched the ball once, leaving nearly all of the backup running back touches to Harris. He gashed the Titans for 5.2 yards per carry but wasn’t involved in the receiving game, limiting his fantasy value. Harris is the clear backup to Cam Skattebo, but he won’t see enough touches to be worth a FLEX spot when the Giants take on the Cardinals next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.headline: Tyrone Tracy Jr., Najee Harris and Devin Singletary are all listed as co-No. 2 backs on New York’s unofficial Week 1 depth chart.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.analysis: We can’t endorse relying on anyone in this backfield as a surefire bellcow in the event that Cam Skattebo gets hurt or is ineffective enough to lose playing time. It seems like it will be hard to rely on Tracy to have a major role this year with Harris in town.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.headline: Giants RB Najee Harris rushed 11 times for 39 yards in Friday’s preseason game against the Jets, adding one reception for 20 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/najee-harr.analysis: Harris saw his first game action since he suffered a torn Achilles last year. The 28-year-old running back had 39 yards on 11 carries and his longest run was for nine yards. Harris added a 20-yard reception, giving him 59 scrimmage yards on 12 opportunities.
